$roomCode..validate: newData.hasChildren(['hostId', 'boardSize', 'matchSize', 'status', 'players']) && newData.child('hostId').isString() && (newData.child('boardSize').val() == 7 || newData.child('boardSize').val() == 9 || newData.child('boardSize').val() == 11) && (newData.child('matchSize').val() == 2 || newData.child('matchSize').val() == 4) && (newData.child('status').val() == 'waiting' || newData.child('status').val() == 'playing')

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'slot']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 16 && newData.child('slot').isNumber() && newData.child('slot').val() >= 0 && newData.child('slot').val() < newData.parent().parent().child('matchSize').val()
